title: MME-Survey: A Comprehensive Survey on Evaluation of Multimodal LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewed via the VLBiasBench benchmark, which evaluates whether multimodal model responses align with human values when presented with age-related stimuli.
Reviewed via the VLBiasBench benchmark, assessing model response alignment with human values regarding gender across different vision-language tasks.
Reviewed via the VLBiasBench benchmark, evaluating how models respond to visual or textual inputs involving physical appearance and whether they align with human values.
Reviewed via the Bingo benchmark, which prompts models with visual questions from diverse regional and cultural contexts to measure performance variations and bias tendencies.

Reviewed via the MM-SpuBench benchmark, which probes models' tendency to rely on false priors or coarse-grained alignments (e.g., common co-occurrences of objects) by evaluating predictions in counterintuitive visual scenarios.
